assertions.subject: Tumor
assertions.predicate: mass extending from the inferior vena cava into the right atrium
assertions.quote: a mass extending from the inferior vena cava into the right atrium in a patient with a history of liver carcinoma is probably a metastasis or a tumor thrombus

assertions.subject: Tumor thrombus
assertions.predicate: consequence of tumor invasion into the venous system
assertions.quote: Tumor thrombus is a consequence of tumor invasion into the venous system, with activation of the coagulation and the simultaneous growth of both tumor and thrombus

assertions.subject: Tumor thrombus
assertions.predicate: frequent in the portal system in patients with hepatocarcinoma
assertions.quote: Tumor thrombi have been reported also in the pulmonary veins. Tumor thrombus is a consequence of tumor invasion into the venous system, with activation of the coagulation and the simultaneous growth of both tumor and thrombus; it is rather frequent in the portal system in patients with hepatocarcinoma

assertions.subject: Myxoma
assertions.predicate: most commonly detected in the left atrium
assertions.quote: Myxomas are most commonly detected in the left atrium

assertions.subject: Papillary fibroelastoma
assertions.predicate: usually attached downstream of the valve
assertions.quote: Unlike vegetations in patients with native valve endocarditis, papillary fibroelastomas are usually attached downstream of the valve

assertions.subject: Angiosarcoma
assertions.predicate: usually originate from the right atrial walls
assertions.quote: Angiosarcomas, the most frequent primary malignant tumor, usually originate from the right atrial walls

assertions.subject: Left atrial tumor
assertions.predicate: occupying also one or more pulmonary veins
assertions.quote: Left atrial tumors occupying also one or more pulmonary veins may be an extension of lung cancer, cardiac or other intrathoracic tumors
